visual_action: Donald Trump and Melania Trump pose for photos on a red carpet. They are dressed in formal evening wear; he is in a black tuxedo and she is in a long black gown. They stand in front of a step-and-repeat backdrop for 'The Kennedy Center HONORS' which also features the CBS logo.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen posing on a red carpet.

cast.name: Melania Trump
cast.evidence: She is shown on screen posing next to Donald Trump on a red carpet.

cast.name: CBS
cast.evidence: The CBS logo is featured on the step-and-repeat backdrop behind the Trumps.

cast.name: The Kennedy Center
cast.evidence: The text 'The Kennedy Center HONORS' is featured on the step-and-repeat backdrop.

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics from a pop song: "Why you so obsessed with me? Boy, I wanna know."
audio_music: A pop/R&B track with a female vocalist plays throughout the video. The tone of the song and its lyrics are taunting and confident.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot of a photograph.
cultural_references: The audio features lyrics from the song 'Obsessed', famously performed by Mariah Carey.
central_claim: Donald and Melania Trump are a glamorous and powerful couple who are unbothered by their critics' constant attention.
intended_effect: To make viewers admire the Trumps and to frame any criticism directed at them as a form of obsession.
